articles.title: Gaza strikes draw condemnation as transition efforts face challenges
articles.titleCn: 加沙袭击遭谴责，过渡努力面临挑战

articles.fullText:
Palestinian Civil Defense personnel extinguish a fire in a destroyed car following an Israeli airstrike on Al-Rashid Road next to the beach in southern Gaza City, August 3, 2026. 
Mediator countries condemned on Monday recent Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip, saying the attacks undermined efforts to implement the second phase of a ceasefire agreement and threatened ongoing diplomatic efforts to end the conflict.
Qatar, Egypt and Türkiye, the mediators in the Gaza ceasefire talks, issued a joint statement expressing "strong condemnation and denunciation of the ongoing Israeli violations in the Gaza Strip."
The mediators said the targeting of healthcare facilities and medical infrastructure, as well as the resulting civilian casualties, constituted a "flagrant violation" of international law and international humanitarian law.
They called on Israel to fulfill its obligations under international law and fully uphold its commitments under the ceasefire agreement, stressing that civilians, medical facilities and humanitarian personnel must be protected and humanitarian aid and medical supplies should be delivered without obstruction.
The three countries also urged the international community to "exert the necessary pressure on Israel" to implement the ceasefire agreement.
The statement came after Israeli strikes reportedly killed dozens of people, including children and other civilians, across the Gaza Strip over the weekend, according to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs.
A displaced Palestinian girl walks past her family's tent with a plastic container balanced on her head to shield herself from the sun in Gaza City, August 2, 2026. 
Mahmoud Basal, spokesperson for the Civil Defense in Gaza, said Israeli drones and helicopters carried out more than 10 airstrikes targeting residential apartments, displacement tents, civilian vehicles and gatherings in areas from northern to southern Gaza.
In a press statement, Hamas called on the mediators and guarantors of the ceasefire agreement to assume their responsibilities, condemn these "Israeli crimes against the Palestinian people," and take immediate action to pressure Israel to cease its aggression in accordance with the agreement.
Palestinian officials also accused Israel of undermining ceasefire efforts. Palestinian presidential spokesperson Nabil Abu Rudeineh said the agreement remained "an agreement on paper while death continues on the ground," urging the international community to take immediate action to ensure implementation of the deal.
Ahmed Majdalani, a member of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of obstructing political progress and delaying an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza.
The latest developments came amid renewed diplomatic efforts over the future of Gaza. The so-called "Board of Peace" said on Monday that its "high representative for Gaza," Nickolay Mladenov, had met with Netanyahu to discuss a proposed deal on the disarmament of Hamas and the transition toward civilian governance.
In a press statement, the board described the meeting as "constructive and detailed," noting the two sides shared an understanding of the ultimate objective of completing the decommissioning of weapons in the enclave and transitioning from rule by the gun to civilian governance.
The board said implementation of the agreement would be overseen by an International Stabilization Force and an Implementation Verification Committee, both of which would include representatives from the United States and the "Board of Peace."
It added that progress toward full implementation depended on all parties fulfilling their obligations under the agreed framework.
On Thursday, US President Donald Trump said the "Board of Peace" had reached an agreement on the "complete disarmament" of Hamas and all other armed groups in Gaza.
On Friday, Hamas said it had agreed to the "latest version of the roadmap" for the second phase of the Gaza ceasefire agreement after "fierce" negotiations.
Gaza health authorities reported that more than 150 fatalities, including dozens of civilians, were documented in July, the deadliest month so far this year.

articles.title: Scientists reveal how aging weakens the brain's protective barrier
articles.titleCn: 科学家揭示衰老如何削弱大脑的保护屏障
articles.summary: Scientists reveal how aging weakens the brain's protective barrier
articles.summaryCn: 研究发现衰老通过TGF-β1信号增加脑内皮细胞转胞吞作用，导致血脑屏障渗漏，进而影响认知功能。

paragraphs.en:
As people age, many experience memory decline and slower {{0}} processing, along with a higher risk of {{1}} disease and cognitive impairment. One important question in aging research is how changes in the brain's blood vessels contribute to cognitive decline. Scientists from the Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences have identified a {{2}} by which aging weakens the blood-brain barrier, the brain's protective {{3}} with the bloodstream. The study was published in Neuron under the title "TGF-β1-induced endothelial {{4}} drives blood-brain barrier leakage during aging."
The study shows how aging {{5}} transport in brain blood vessel cells, leading to blood-brain barrier leakage. /SIAT
The blood-brain barrier, or BBB, acts as a {{6}} security system.
paragraphs.cn: 随着人们年龄增长，许多人会经历记忆力下降和认知处理速度变慢，同时患脑血管疾病和认知障碍的风险也会增加。衰老研究中的一个重要问题是，大脑血管的变化如何导致认知衰退。中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院（SIAT）的科学家们识别出衰老削弱血脑屏障（大脑与血液之间的保护性界面）的一种机制。该研究发表在《神经元》杂志上，题为“TGF-β1诱导的内皮转胞吞作用驱动衰老过程中的血脑屏障渗漏”。该研究展示了衰老如何扰乱脑血管细胞中的运输，导致血脑屏障渗漏。/SIAT 血脑屏障（BBB）像一个选择性安全系统。

paragraphs.en: It allows {{7}} nutrients to reach the brain while preventing potentially harmful substances in the blood from entering brain tissue. Damage to this barrier has been linked to cognitive aging, cerebral small vessel disease and several {{8}} disorders. Scientists have traditionally {{9}} BBB leakage mainly to damage to the tight seals between cells lining brain blood vessels. However, the new study found that another process occurs earlier during aging. By examining mice at different ages, the researchers found that BBB leakage was already {{10}} in middle-aged mice and worsened in older animals.
paragraphs.cn: 它允许必需营养物质到达大脑，同时防止血液中潜在有害物质进入脑组织。这种屏障的损伤与认知老化、脑小血管疾病以及多种神经退行性疾病有关。科学家传统上将血脑屏障渗漏主要归因于脑内血管内壁细胞之间紧密连接的损伤。然而，这项新研究发现，在衰老过程中另一个过程发生得更早。通过检查不同年龄的小鼠，研究人员发现，血脑屏障渗漏在中年小鼠中已经可检测到，并在老年动物中恶化。

paragraphs.en: The change appeared early in the {{11}}, a brain region important for learning and memory. At this stage, the seals between blood vessel cells remained largely {{12}}. Instead, the cells' internal transport system became {{13}} active, allowing blood-borne substances to pass through the cells and enter brain tissue. "Rather than first leaking through gaps between cells, the aging blood-brain barrier appears to lose control over transport pathways inside the cells," the researchers said. The team identified a protein called Mfsd2a as an important part of this protective system.
paragraphs.cn: 这种变化早期出现在海马体，这是一个对学习和记忆重要的大脑区域。在这个阶段，血管细胞之间的连接基本保持完整。相反，细胞内部的运输系统变得异常活跃，允许血液中的物质穿过细胞进入脑组织。“衰老的血脑屏障似乎并非首先通过细胞间隙渗漏，而是失去了对细胞内运输通路的控制，”研究人员说。该团队识别出一种名为Mfsd2a的蛋白质，作为这一保护系统的重要组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Mfsd2a normally limits unnecessary transport across brain blood vessels. Its levels declined with age, while Caveolin-1, a protein involved in the formation of transport vesicles, increased. When the researchers {{14}} endothelial Mfsd2a expression or knocked down Caveolin-1 in aged mice, abnormal vesicle transport and BBB leakage were significantly reduced. The researchers then investigated why Mfsd2a declines during aging. They found that levels of TGF-β1, a signaling molecule involved in inflammation, tissue repair and aging, increased in both the brain and the bloodstream as mice aged.
paragraphs.cn: Mfsd2a通常限制大脑血管中不必要的运输。其水平随年龄增长而下降，而参与运输囊泡形成的蛋白质Caveolin-1则增加。当研究人员在老年小鼠中恢复内皮Mfsd2a表达或敲低Caveolin-1时，异常囊泡运输和血脑屏障渗漏显著减少。研究人员随后调查了为什么Mfsd2a在衰老过程中下降。他们发现，随着小鼠年龄增长，大脑和血液中TGF-β1（一种参与炎症、组织修复和衰老的信号分子）的水平均增加。

paragraphs.en: Excessive TGF-β1 reduced Mfsd2a expression in the cells lining brain blood vessels, causing their transport activity to increase. Raising TGF-β1 levels in young mice caused them to develop several features normally seen in the aged BBB, including increased leakage. By contrast, {{16}} TGF-β signaling in aged mice reduced BBB leakage and improved their performance in memory-related behavioral tests. The findings suggest that age-related BBB damage is not simply the result of {{17}} wear and tear. Instead, it involves biological signals that alter how brain blood vessel cells transport substances.
paragraphs.cn: 过量的TGF-β1降低了脑血管内壁细胞中Mfsd2a的表达，导致其运输活性增加。在年轻小鼠中提高TGF-β1水平，使它们出现通常在衰老血脑屏障中观察到的多种特征，包括渗漏增加。相比之下，在老年小鼠中阻断TGF-β信号可减少血脑屏障渗漏，并改善它们在记忆相关行为测试中的表现。这些发现表明，与年龄相关的血脑屏障损伤并非仅仅是被动磨损的结果。相反，它涉及改变脑血管细胞运输物质方式的生物信号。

paragraphs.en: The study may help explain how vascular changes contribute to cognitive aging. It also points to potential approaches for protecting the aging brain, including maintaining Mfsd2a function or preventing {{15}} activation of TGF-β signaling. Further research will be needed to determine whether these {{18}} can be safely translated into treatments for humans.
paragraphs.cn: 这项研究可能有助于解释血管变化如何导致认知老化。它还指出了保护衰老大脑的潜在方法，包括维持Mfsd2a功能或防止TGF-β信号过度激活。需要进一步研究来确定这些策略是否能安全地转化为针对人类的治疗方法。

articles.fullText:
As people age, many experience memory decline and slower cognitive processing, along with a higher risk of cerebrovascular disease and cognitive impairment. One important question in aging research is how changes in the brain's blood vessels contribute to cognitive decline.
Scientists from the Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences have identified a mechanism by which aging weakens the blood-brain barrier, the brain's protective interface with the bloodstream.
The study was published in Neuron under the title "TGF-β1-induced endothelial transcytosis drives blood-brain barrier leakage during aging."
The study shows how aging disrupts transport in brain blood vessel cells, leading to blood-brain barrier leakage. /SIAT
The blood-brain barrier, or BBB, acts as a selective security system. It allows essential nutrients to reach the brain while preventing potentially harmful substances in the blood from entering brain tissue. Damage to this barrier has been linked to cognitive aging, cerebral small vessel disease and several neurodegenerative disorders.
Scientists have traditionally attributed BBB leakage mainly to damage to the tight seals between cells lining brain blood vessels. However, the new study found that another process occurs earlier during aging.
By examining mice at different ages, the researchers found that BBB leakage was already detectable in middle-aged mice and worsened in older animals. The change appeared early in the hippocampus, a brain region important for learning and memory.
At this stage, the seals between blood vessel cells remained largely intact. Instead, the cells' internal transport system became abnormally active, allowing blood-borne substances to pass through the cells and enter brain tissue.
"Rather than first leaking through gaps between cells, the aging blood-brain barrier appears to lose control over transport pathways inside the cells," the researchers said.
The team identified a protein called Mfsd2a as an important part of this protective system. Mfsd2a normally limits unnecessary transport across brain blood vessels. Its levels declined with age, while Caveolin-1, a protein involved in the formation of transport vesicles, increased.
When the researchers restored endothelial Mfsd2a expression or knocked down Caveolin-1 in aged mice, abnormal vesicle transport and BBB leakage were significantly reduced.
The researchers then investigated why Mfsd2a declines during aging. They found that levels of TGF-β1, a signaling molecule involved in inflammation, tissue repair and aging, increased in both the brain and the bloodstream as mice aged.
Excessive TGF-β1 reduced Mfsd2a expression in the cells lining brain blood vessels, causing their transport activity to increase. Raising TGF-β1 levels in young mice caused them to develop several features normally seen in the aged BBB, including increased leakage.
By contrast, blocking TGF-β signaling in aged mice reduced BBB leakage and improved their performance in memory-related behavioral tests.
The findings suggest that age-related BBB damage is not simply the result of passive wear and tear. Instead, it involves biological signals that alter how brain blood vessel cells transport substances.
The study may help explain how vascular changes contribute to cognitive aging. It also points to potential approaches for protecting the aging brain, including maintaining Mfsd2a function or preventing excessive activation of TGF-β signaling. Further research will be needed to determine whether these strategies can be safely translated into treatments for humans.
articles.fullTextCn:
随着人们年龄增长，许多人会经历记忆力下降和认知处理速度变慢，同时患脑血管疾病和认知障碍的风险也会增加。衰老研究中的一个重要问题是，大脑血管的变化如何导致认知衰退。中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院（SIAT）的科学家们识别出衰老削弱血脑屏障（大脑与血液之间的保护性界面）的一种机制。该研究发表在《神经元》杂志上，题为“TGF-β1诱导的内皮转胞吞作用驱动衰老过程中的血脑屏障渗漏”。该研究展示了衰老如何扰乱脑血管细胞中的运输，导致血脑屏障渗漏。/SIAT 血脑屏障（BBB）像一个选择性安全系统。

它允许必需营养物质到达大脑，同时防止血液中潜在有害物质进入脑组织。这种屏障的损伤与认知老化、脑小血管疾病以及多种神经退行性疾病有关。科学家传统上将血脑屏障渗漏主要归因于脑内血管内壁细胞之间紧密连接的损伤。然而，这项新研究发现，在衰老过程中另一个过程发生得更早。通过检查不同年龄的小鼠，研究人员发现，血脑屏障渗漏在中年小鼠中已经可检测到，并在老年动物中恶化。

这种变化早期出现在海马体，这是一个对学习和记忆重要的大脑区域。在这个阶段，血管细胞之间的连接基本保持完整。相反，细胞内部的运输系统变得异常活跃，允许血液中的物质穿过细胞进入脑组织。“衰老的血脑屏障似乎并非首先通过细胞间隙渗漏，而是失去了对细胞内运输通路的控制，”研究人员说。该团队识别出一种名为Mfsd2a的蛋白质，作为这一保护系统的重要组成部分。

Mfsd2a通常限制大脑血管中不必要的运输。其水平随年龄增长而下降，而参与运输囊泡形成的蛋白质Caveolin-1则增加。当研究人员在老年小鼠中恢复内皮Mfsd2a表达或敲低Caveolin-1时，异常囊泡运输和血脑屏障渗漏显著减少。研究人员随后调查了为什么Mfsd2a在衰老过程中下降。他们发现，随着小鼠年龄增长，大脑和血液中TGF-β1（一种参与炎症、组织修复和衰老的信号分子）的水平均增加。

过量的TGF-β1降低了脑血管内壁细胞中Mfsd2a的表达，导致其运输活性增加。在年轻小鼠中提高TGF-β1水平，使它们出现通常在衰老血脑屏障中观察到的多种特征，包括渗漏增加。相比之下，在老年小鼠中阻断TGF-β信号可减少血脑屏障渗漏，并改善它们在记忆相关行为测试中的表现。这些发现表明，与年龄相关的血脑屏障损伤并非仅仅是被动磨损的结果。相反，它涉及改变脑血管细胞运输物质方式的生物信号。

这项研究可能有助于解释血管变化如何导致认知老化。它还指出了保护衰老大脑的潜在方法，包括维持Mfsd2a功能或防止TGF-β信号过度激活。需要进一步研究来确定这些策略是否能安全地转化为针对人类的治疗方法。

articles.fullText:
The 25th China Internet Conference opens at the China National Convention Center in Beijing, capital of China, July 8, 2026. 
Artificial intelligence is moving rapidly from experimental technology to real-world applications, as industry leaders showcased new AI-powered solutions for cities, businesses and consumers at the 25th China Internet Conference in Beijing.
Held from July 8 to 10, the conference highlighted how AI agents, large language models and digital twin technologies are being integrated into sectors ranging from urban governance and industrial manufacturing to retail and public services.
Speaking via video at the opening ceremony, Wu Hequan, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, said AI-native technologies are reshaping the internet itself.
While large language models excel at general reasoning, AI agents are designed to execute specific tasks and future digital ecosystems will increasingly rely on collaboration among multiple intelligent agents rather than isolated AI systems.
Participants of the 25th China Internet Conference try on VR products at the China National Convention Center in Beijing, capital of China, July 8, 2026. 
According to Wu, AI-generated traffic is expected to account for around 60% of global internet traffic by 2030, with AI agent services becoming the dominant source of token-based interactions. The shift, he said, will require internet infrastructure to evolve toward higher bandwidth, lower latency and stronger computing capabilities.
The conference also demonstrated how AI is being deployed in practical scenarios. Digital assistants are supporting office collaboration and customer services, while AI-powered inspection systems are improving industrial operations. Digital twin technologies are enabling more efficient traffic management, energy optimization and building maintenance, providing city managers with real-time visualization and decision-making tools.
Industry representatives also emphasized that AI innovation is creating measurable economic value.
Participants of the 25th China Internet Conference interact with humanoid robots at the China National Convention Center in Beijing, capital of China, July 8, 2026. 
At the conference, Kuaishou said its AI-powered video generation model and digital human live-streaming platform have helped small and medium-sized businesses increase daily gross merchandise value while significantly reducing marketing costs. Alibaba's Taobao Instant Commerce platform reported that AI agents are increasingly handling complex shopping requests, moving beyond traditional keyword-based searches to task-oriented consumer services.
Beyond applications, participants identified trustworthy AI and green computing as key priorities for the industry's next stage of development. The launch of the FlagOS Initiative, an open AI software platform designed to improve compatibility across different computing chips, reflects broader efforts to build more efficient and sustainable AI infrastructure.
As AI technologies continue to mature, industry experts believe the focus is shifting from developing models to deploying them at scale. The conference highlighted China's efforts to accelerate AI adoption across the real economy, with intelligent applications increasingly becoming part of everyday life while supporting digital transformation and high-quality economic development.

articles.fullText:
Sun Lei, chargé d'affaires of China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations, speaks at a UN Security Council meeting, August 5, 2026. /CMG
A Chinese envoy on Wednesday called for stronger international governance of emerging technologies to fight terrorism.
Addressing the UN Security Council, Sun Lei, the charge d'affaires of China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations, said terrorist groups are increasingly using the Internet, artificial intelligence, drones and other emerging technologies for incitement, recruitment, financing and attacks, posing new challenges to global counter-terrorism efforts.
He urged the international community to improve risk assessment and regulatory frameworks and prevent "the 'three forces' of violent terrorism, ethnic separatism and religious extremism from exploiting emerging technologies to spread and infiltrate."
Sun also called for greater support for developing countries through technology transfer, training and information-sharing to strengthen their counter-terrorism capabilities.
Reaffirming that terrorism remains a serious threat to international peace and security, Sun said the international community should uphold cooperation, reject the politicization of counter-terrorism and strengthen coordinated action.
Stressing the need to address terrorist threats in Syria and Afghanistan, he urged Syria's transitional government to take firm action against all terrorist organizations listed by the Security Council, including the East Turkestan Islamic Movement. Sun called on the Afghan authorities to fulfill their counter-terrorism commitments and prevent the country from becoming a base for terrorist activities again.
The Chinese envoy also expressed concerns over the security situation in Africa's Sahel region, calling for stronger international support in border management, intelligence-sharing and capacity building while respecting the sovereignty of regional countries. He said the United Nations should deepen cooperation with the African Union and advance development to tackle the root causes of terrorism.
Sun said China will continue to promote international counter-terrorism cooperation under frameworks including the United Nations, the Shanghai Cooperation Organization and BRICS, and work with all parties to combat terrorism in all its forms.

中国常驻联合国代表团临时代办孙磊在联合国安理会会议上发言，呼吁加强新兴技术的国际治理以打击恐怖主义。他在安理会发言时指出，恐怖组织越来越多地利用互联网、人工智能、无人机等新兴技术进行煽动、招募、融资和袭击，对全球反恐努力构成新挑战。他敦促国际社会完善风险评估和监管框架，防止“暴力恐怖势力、民族分裂势力、宗教极端势力”这“三股势力”利用新兴技术进行传播和渗透。

孙磊还呼吁通过技术转让、培训和信息共享加大对发展中国家的支持，以增强其反恐能力。他重申恐怖主义仍是国际和平与安全的严重威胁，并表示国际社会应坚持合作，反对将反恐政治化，加强协调行动。

在强调应对叙利亚和阿富汗恐怖威胁的必要性时，他敦促叙利亚过渡政府采取坚决行动，打击安理会列名的所有恐怖组织，包括“东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动”。孙磊呼吁阿富汗当局履行反恐承诺，防止该国再次成为恐怖活动的基地。这位中国外交官还对非洲萨赫勒地区的安全局势表示关切，呼吁在尊重地区国家主权的同时，加强国际社会在边境管理、情报共享和能力建设方面的支持。他表示，联合国应深化与非盟的合作，推进发展以消除恐怖主义根源。孙磊表示，中国将继续在联合国、上海合作组织和金砖国家等框架下推动国际反恐合作，与各方一道打击一切形式的恐怖主义。

A Chinese defense spokesperson on Tuesday slammed Japan's annual defense white paper for spreading false narratives and hyping a so-called security crisis in the region.
Chen Xi, a spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defense, made the remarks in response to a media query regarding Japan's newly released defense white paper, which labels China's military developments an "unprecedented and the greatest strategic challenge" and claims that "China has intensified its military activities around Taiwan."
The white paper is full of false narratives and deliberately hypes a so-called security crisis in the region and the "China threat," Chen said, describing Japan's actions as "a thief crying 'Stop thief'" so as to create a pretext for its own military buildup.
China is strongly dissatisfied with and firmly opposes such moves, he said.
Under the pretext of an "exclusively defense-oriented policy," the Japanese government is accelerating revisions to its three key security documents, continuously increasing defense spending, developing long-range offensive capabilities, and advancing the weaponization and militarization of space and the battlefield, Chen pointed out.
Japan is even portraying the expansion of its defense industry as a driver of economic growth, in an attempt to deeply embed military expansion and war preparations into its national institutions, economy, industry and public discourse, he added.
Japan's "new militarism" has become increasingly entrenched and poses a serious challenge to the postwar international order, as well as a genuine threat to regional peace and stability, Chen said.
The Taiwan question concerns China's sovereignty and territorial integrity and constitutes the political foundation of China-Japan relations. It is a red line that must not be crossed, he stressed.
Chen urged Japan to deeply reflect on its history of aggression, stop interfering in China's internal affairs, and stop misleading the Japanese public and the international community.

周二，一位中国国防部发言人抨击日本年度防卫白皮书散布不实叙事并炒作所谓的地区安全危机。国防部发言人陈曦在回应有关日本新发布防卫白皮书的媒体提问时发表了上述言论，该白皮书将中国的军事发展称为“前所未有的最大战略挑战”，并声称“中国在台湾周边加强了军事活动”。

陈曦表示，该白皮书充满不实叙事，蓄意炒作所谓的地区安全危机和“中国威胁”，并形容日本的行为是“贼喊捉贼”，旨在为其自身军事扩张制造借口。他说，中国对此强烈不满并坚决反对。陈曦指出，日本政府以“专守防卫”政策为借口，正在加速修订其三项关键安全文件，不断增加国防开支，发展远程进攻能力，并推进太空和战场的武器化与军事化。他补充说，日本甚至将国防工业的扩张描绘为经济增长的驱动力，试图将军事扩张和战争准备深度嵌入其国家机构、经济、工业和公共话语中。陈曦表示，日本的“新军国主义”日益根深蒂固，对战后国际秩序构成严重挑战，也对地区和平与稳定构成真正威胁。他强调，台湾问题事关中国的主权和领土完整，是中日关系的政治基础，是不可逾越的红线。陈曦敦促日本深刻反思其侵略历史，停止干涉中国内政，停止误导日本公众和国际社会。
